title: Nine Head of Winter
subtitle: 牲畜与牧养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 牲畜与牧养（自然生态·动物与牧业）
meta: 主题语境：牲畜与牧养（自然生态·动物与牧业）　|　核心词汇：cattle　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cattle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to count ① cattle she could not hold, and she said the holding was the whole of the lesson. The ② cattle, meaning the beasts and not the herd, were nine head and were counted by whoever came last; cattle, she said, are the only thing in a field that is judged by how much has been taken out of them.

Every ③ cattle in that field had the same bell, and the ④ cattle at the end, meaning the ones the drover kept and not either of those, were the only ones anybody ever counted properly. Cattle, my grandmother said, are nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cattle were the whole of the farm, meaning the living they carried and not the beasts. The ⑥ cattle, meaning the living and not any of that, are the only thing in a valley that everybody sells and nobody questions; cattle, he said, are either something you count or the only word that means both beasts and a living. She said the living is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ cattle had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the bell. The ⑧ cattle of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, were nine head and eleven years of counting; cattle, she said, are either the ones at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cattle I remember are the ones at the end, which were sold in 1972 and are still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ head of cattle, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being counted; every cattle, she said, is a living that has agreed to look like beasts. She said the living was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 牛（指那些牲口本身，与整个牛群相对）
C. 固定搭配：count cattle 清点牛的头数
D. n. 牛（指地里每一群）
E. n. 牛（指末尾那一群）
F. n. 牛（抽象：它们承载的那份生计）
G. n. 那份生计（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The cattle, meaning the beasts and not the herd
cattle were the whole of the farm
the cattle had become a number in a report
The cattle of the whole thing
A head of cattle, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: count cattle 意为“清点牛的头数”，1951 年母亲被派去清点她拦不住的牛。
cattle 意为“牛、牲畜”，指那些牲口本身而不是整个牛群，共九头，由最后走的人清点。
cattle 指地里每一群牛，每一群都是同样的铃铛。
cattle 指末尾那一群（赶牛人管的一群），是唯一有人认真清点过的。
cattle 意为“牛”，抽象指它们承载的那份生计，父亲说 cattle 就是那个农场的全部。
cattle 为抽象用法，指那份生计本身，是山谷里人人都卖、却没人质疑的东西。
cattle 意为“牛、牲畜”，到 1967 年这些 cattle 成了报告里的一个数字。
cattle 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九头牛和十一年的清点。
cattle 意为“牛”，我记得的是末尾那一群，1972 年卖掉，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
cattle 为抽象总称，祖母说一头牛是唯一会因为被认真清点而变好的东西。

The cattle, meaning the beasts and not the herd, were nine head and were counted by whoever came last.

The cattle at the end, meaning the ones the drover kept and not either of those, were the only ones anybody ever counted properly.
